page.overview:
Who is Bar Hopper?

The Bar Hopper is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"As Flik walks past the bar, he passes a grasshopper toasting a fly with a bubble of Black Flag. "A hair of the dog you bit," the 'hopper says. The fly has probably heard that old joke a million time, but he doesn't mind. It is said in the spirit of friend-sips."
